title: Building durable workflows on Postgres
summary: This article demonstrates how to build durable, fault-tolerant workflows using PostgreSQL as the core persistence layer, leveraging features like transactions, advisory locks, and SKIP LOCKED to create reliable workflow execution without specialized orchestration frameworks.
problem_solved: Eliminates the need for complex distributed workflow/orchestration systems by using Postgres's built-in durability features to handle failure recovery and reliable execution.
why_valuable: Reduces infrastructure complexity by allowing a single database to handle both data storage and durable workflow orchestration, which is particularly valuable for developers already using Postgres.
